ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Promptly uses the camera to record your videos. Recordings stay on your device.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Promptly records your voice with your video and can follow your speech to scroll the script.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Voice Follow and automatic captions use speech recognition. Promptly asks for on-device processing where available.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Promptly saves your exported videos to your photo library.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Promptly saves your exported videos to your photo library.
